_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bamidbar 2, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
translations.2: Each tribe in its station, with signs for their fathers' houses — the sons of Israel shall encamp; facing the tent of the Presence, and around it they shall encamp.
translations.3: And those encamping in the east: the station of the camp of Judah, by their hosts; and their noble is Nahshon son of Amminadab.
translations.4: And the count of his host: seventy-four thousand six hundred.
translations.5: And those encamping beside him: the tribe of Issachar; and their noble is Nethanel son of Zuar.
translations.6: And the count of his host: fifty-four thousand four hundred.
translations.7: Beside him: the tribe of Zebulun; and their noble is Eliab son of Helon.
translations.8: And the count of his host: fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
translations.9: That, then, is the whole count of the camp of Judah: a hundred thousand, and eighty-six thousand and four hundred, by their hosts. And they shall set out first.
translations.10: The station of the camp of Reuben, in the south, by their hosts; and their noble is Elizur son of Shedeur.
translations.11: And the count of his host: forty-six thousand five hundred.
translations.12: And those encamping beside him: the tribe of Simeon; and their noble is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
translations.13: And the count of his host: fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
translations.14: And beside him: the tribe of Gad; and their noble is Eliasaph son of Reuel.
translations.15: And the count of his host: forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
translations.16: That, then, is the whole count of the camp of Reuben: a hundred and fifty-one thousand, and four hundred and fifty, by their hosts. And they shall set out second.
translations.17: And the tent of the Presence shall set out — the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp; and as they encamp, so shall they set out, each group in its place and its station.
translations.18: The station of the camp of Ephraim, by their hosts, in the west; and their noble is Elishama son of Ammihud.
translations.19: And the count of his host: forty thousand five hundred.
translations.20: Beside him: the tribe of Manasseh; and their noble is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
translations.21: And the count of his host: thirty-two thousand two hundred.
translations.22: And beside him: the tribe of Benjamin; and their noble is Abidan son of Gideoni.
translations.23: And the count of his host: thirty-five thousand four hundred.
translations.24: That, then, is the whole count of the camp of Ephraim: a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, by their hosts. And they shall set out third.
translations.25: And the station of the camp of Dan, in the north, by their hosts; and their noble is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
translations.26: And the count of his host: sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
translations.27: And those encamping beside him: the tribe of Asher; and their noble is Pagiel son of Ochran.
translations.28: And the count of his host: forty-one thousand five hundred.
translations.29: And beside him: the tribe of Naphtali; and their noble is Ahira son of Enan.
translations.31: That, then, is the whole count of the camp of Dan: a hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred. And they shall set out last, by their hosts.
translations.32: These are those counted of the sons of Israel, by their fathers' houses; the total count of the camp, by their hosts: six hundred thousand and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.
translations.33: As for the Levites, they were not counted in the total of the sons of Israel, as God had commanded Moses.
translations.34: And then the sons of Israel did as God had commanded Moses: thus they encamped in their stations, and thus they set out — each tribe by their clans, according to their fathers' houses.
translations.36: And the count of his host: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
